errors.evidence: The description states that the vertical axis appears to represent a percentage or a count, but it fails to specify that the values are percentages, information which is explicitly provided in the figure's caption ("% от всички").
The description identifies the color of the bars for the "Да" (Yes) category as "син" (blue), when they are clearly teal or cyan.
The description incorrectly states that there is no additional visual emphasis, completely omitting the dotted vertical line that separates the first category group ("От всички") from the other two.
